entities.name: Iki Hisoka
entities.description: Sensei and headmaster of the Minamo Academy on Kamigawa, killed by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Minamo Academy
entities.description: School headed by Hisoka, mostly destroyed by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Ogre shaman who destroyed most of Minamo and killed Hisoka.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: Apprentice of Hidetsugu killed by Choryu.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Performed the crime that started the Kami War.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: Smiling Kami of the Crescent Moon who made Hisoka a puppet.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moon-dwelling people who made Hisoka a puppet.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Ogre faction that avenged Kobo upon the school.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War started by Konda's crime in Eiganjo.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: City where Hisoka was present for Konda's crime.

events.summary: Hisoka becomes first a teacher and later headmaster of the Minamo Academy.
events.quote: he became first a teacher, and later headmaster of the school

events.summary: Hisoka is present in Eiganjo when Konda commits the crime that starts the Kami War.
events.quote: He was present in Eiganjo when Konda performed the crime that started the Kami War

events.summary: Choryu kills Kobo, bringing the Hyozan Reckoners' revenge upon the school.
events.quote: he brought the revenge of the Hyozan Reckoners upon the school

events.summary: Hidetsugu destroys most of the school and refuses Hisoka's parley.
events.quote: When the ogre attacked and destroyed most of the school
Hisoka's life ended in the jaws of Hidetsugu
